item.title: Hoosiers fans return home after Rose Bowl victory
item.description: Thousands of Indiana University football fans on Friday returned home victorious from the Rose Bowl, where they celebrated a 38-3 win over Alabama in the College Football Playoff.

item.title: Slow thaw after a cold weekend | Jan. 3, 2026
item.description: The 7 day forecast predicts a cold and dry weekend, followed by a warming trend with highs in the 50s and a chance of rain late week.

item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (AP) — Ryan Sabol’s 22 points helped Buffalo defeat Ball State 85-72 on Saturday. Sabol also added five assists for the Bulls (13-2, 3-0 Mid-American Conference). item.title: Lindsay scores 18, Villanova downs Butler
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (AP) — Bryce Lindsay scored 18 points as Villanova beat Butler 85-67 on Saturday. Lindsay went 7 of 13 from the field (3 for 7 from 3-point range) for the Wildcats (12-2, 3-0 Big East Conference). item.title: 4 rifles taken from Crawfordsville department store; ATF seeks tips
item.description: A person stole four rifles from a Crawfordsville, Indiana, department store on the evening of Dec. 30, 2025, and federal authorities and a shooting sports group are offering a possible reward for information.

item.title: Trump carries out overnight strike on Venezuela, captures Maduro and his wife
item.description: The US launched a large-scale strike against Venezuela, capturing President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, and flying them out of the country, prompting Colombia to prepare for a potential influx of refugees and Russia to condemn the US action as an act of armed aggression.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers react to U.S. strikes on Venezuela, capture of Maduro
item.description: Indiana's congressional delegation has expressed a range of reactions to the U.S. capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, with some expressing support and others questioning the legality of the military action.
